STILLROOT'S SONG   |   PLAYER HANDOUT

Closing entries

P. Voss, Humblenook: five loaves, paid.

E. Senn, Hearthhouse: tea bread, collect after supper.

S. Venn: red cloth returned. Three diagonal stitches. Left cuff.

C. Flint: no more glass jars. The ringing carries through them.

Nella collected the parcels.

Wax in both ears. Not one. BOTH.

I remembered the older smith. Oren Halden. I have written it here before I tell myself I did not.

The sound came back when I took the wax out.

Do it again. Check it. Do not let them call it a dream.
